summary: In-trade order-flow autopsy: winners vs losers once IN the position, with adversarial verify

result.summary: Depth-evolution and price-path screen of 713 trades (520/442/315 alive at h=3/5/10). The PRICE-PATH family dominates; the DEPTH family is mostly null standalone but adds signal in interactions. Earliest-reliable horizon is h=3 for every passing rule. Loser flags passing both-years criteria: (1) r_3<0 - simply being underwater 3min after fill: wr 0.18/0.15 (2025/2026) vs 0.49/0.55 in profit, gaps +31/+40pp, robust in every book/pattern slice and in Jul-Sep 2025 (0.15 vs 0.39); (2) deep-red r_3<=-0.36R (2025 q25): wr 0.05/0.11 - near-certain loss; (3) maeR_3>=0.76 (2025 q75): wr 0.13/0.19, +29/+25pp - drawdown depth flags losers even after recovery, consistent with winners' median final MAE of 0.37R; (4) the composite maeR>=0.5 AND r<0 is the cleanest cut rule, ~+30pp at every horizon both years; (5) r<0 AND dthick<0 (underwater while book drains) passes at h=3/5, with dthick contributing only when conditioned on being underwater; (6) wallb_3==1 (depth appearing behind the position - trapped-crowd signature) passes at h=3 (+13/+16pp, Rgap +0.53/+0.58) but on thin cells (n~25/yr) - promising, not proven. Winner-only mirror states (both years, all/most horizons): r_h>0 alone (+21 to +46pp), r>0 AND book building dthick>0 at h=3/5 (h=5 2026: wr 0.72), and r>0 AND maeR<0.37 (green and never stressed) at all horizons. Honest nulls: eff_* dead everywhere; dimb_* dead everywhere including interactions; dthick standalone is a 2026-only effect that fails 2025; wallb uncertifiable past h=3 for sample size. Jul-Sep 2025 (the worst regime, base wr 0.23) confirms direction of every headline rule. Structural read: losers reveal themselves within 3 minutes by price position and excursion depth, secondarily by liquidity draining while underwater and by late size parking behind the trade; winners are in profit early with shallow MAE and a thickening book.
nulls: eff_* (price-path efficiency) is NULL at every horizon in both directions: low-eff flag flips sign across years (2025 h=10 gap -13pp vs 2026 +10pp); high-eff flag never exceeds +6pp. Efficiency carries no reliable loser signal in this data.

dthick_* standalone is NULL at all horizons: draining book (dthick<=q25 or dthick<0) shows +16 to +29pp in 2026 but is flat-to-inverted in 2025 (-12 to +3pp). 2026-only effect; fails the two-year rule. Only works conditioned on r<0 (see finding) or on the winner side (r>0 & dthick>0).
dimb_* (imbalance rotation) is NULL at all horizons in both tails (q25 and q75 flags all within -7 to +11pp, inconsistent sign). The book-imbalance-shift feature carries no loser signal here.
maeR>=median AND dimb<0 interaction is NULL (2025 gaps +5/-1/0pp) - dimb adds nothing to maeR.
wallb at h=5 and h=10: flag cells n<20 in at least one year (n=12-21), cannot certify despite consistent +26 to +31pp direction. Same for r<0 & wallb==1 at all horizons (max n=20 in 2025 h=3).
r<0 & dthick<0 at h=10: 2026 flag n=17, below floor (direction +47pp).
maeR>=0.5 at h=10 fails the win-rate criterion in 2025 (+9pp) - passes only via mean-R gap.
maeR<0.25 winner flag at h=10 fails 2025 (+9pp).
Pattern A too small to slice (n=55 total). Book/pattern slices only certified for r<0 and maeR>=q75 at h=3/5 (all directions hold where n>=20).

Caveat applying to all findings: horizon-h features exist only for trades still alive at h (520/442/315 of 713 at h=3/5/10), so these rules apply to alive trades only; alive-at-h base win rates are higher (35-48%) than the full-book 29%.
